name: Camp Wigwam
description_short: Overnight summer camp on Bear Lake in Waterford, Maine, running since 1910. It offers a full-summer session, two half-summer sessions with trips, and shorter Rookie sessions for first-time campers age 11 and under.
refund_policy_summary: A $750 deposit is due at registration. Enrollment can be cancelled without obligation before February 1. If camp is not the right fit, the camp will work with the family on a prorated tuition refund.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp is on Bear Lake (40 acres). The page gives no details on swimming or the waterfront.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: Early-bird offer (pay in full before October 1 to lock in the previous year's rate) has likely passed as of 2026-10-13.
Two phone numbers are listed: Summer (207) 583-2300 and Winter (301) 785-6740. The summer number was recorded; in the off-season, the winter number may be the right one.
Visiting Day (Saturday, July 24, 2027) falls on the last day of First Session.
The page's resources link to a 2026 Parent Handbook, not a 2027 one.
